# allinkl_subdomains (Data Source)

Reads all subdomains of the KAS account with their host settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "allinkl_subdomains" "all" {}

output "subdomains_without_tls" {
  value = [for s in data.allinkl_subdomains.all.subdomains : s.fqdn if !s.tls.active]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `subdomains` (Attributes List) Every subdomain of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subdomains))

<a id="nestedatt--subdomains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subdomains`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the host is served.
- `fqdn` (String) Full host name.
- `path` (String) Document root path, or the redirect target.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version the host runs.
- `redirect_status` (Number) Redirect status: 0, 301, 302 or 307.
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS state of the host, as KAS reports it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subdomains--tls))

<a id="nestedatt--subdomains--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subdomains.tls`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is served.
- `force_https` (Boolean) Whether HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS.
- `hsts_max_age` (Number) HSTS max-age in seconds; `-1` when HSTS is off.
- `lets_encrypt` (Boolean) Whether the certificate was issued by Let's Encrypt through the KAS panel.
- `type` (String) Certificate type as KAS names it; `LE90D` is a Let's Encrypt certificate issued through the panel.
